confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Lima prices, not checked against live listings or current menus. Restaurant anchors are more reliable than hotel and hostel anchors, which vary more by district (Miraflores, Barranco, Centro). The FX observation (2026-10-15) was taken from a search-result summary that attributes it to the RBA exchange rates page; the RBA page was not opened directly. A later 2026-10-16 figure from a third-party site was not used because it is not an RBA observation.
comparable_city_reasoning: No specific comparable city was used. Estimates are based on the general price level of mid-sized South American capitals, with Lima's mid-range restaurant and Miraflores hotel demand taken into account.
